name: Acid Design
summary: Acid Design is a graphic design style characterized by psychedelic visuals, distorted typography, and futuristic textures.
description: Acid Design is a graphic design style characterized by psychedelic visuals, distorted typography, and futuristic textures. Its origins are rooted in the flyer art of the 1990s Acid House and rave movements. The style experienced a significant revival in the mid-2010s, primarily on social media platforms like Instagram, where this new wave became widely known as Acidgrafix . [ 1 ] It is commonly found in electronic music cover art, event flyers, and branding for fashion and music labels. The aesthetic combines a dark, often black, background with highly saturated neon colors, complex compositions, and motifs drawn from technology and counter-culture. [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Individuality, uniqueness, visual dissonance, cynical humor, futurism
